Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in
Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for this, if that's fine.
Q: That's acceptable. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pearland, in the right lane. I had been waiting maybe half a minute
when I felt a hard jolt from behind.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Only in the mirror, for a second. It looked like it was coming up fast, and I braced myself on the wheel. There
wasn't time to do anything else.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was traveling?
A: I really can't say. It seemed quicker than traffic around it, but I'm not good at judging speed from a mirror.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did your airbags deploy?
A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not come out, I don't think.
Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?
A: I think my head snapped back and hit the headrest, and then forward. Right after, I had a headache, ringing in my
ears, and I felt foggy and kind of nauseous.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I was taken to an urgent care clinic and later saw my primary doctor. They told me I have a concussion and
I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?
A: Some of them, yes. Bright lights bother me, and I get tired by the afternoon. I'm trying to take it easy.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm glad no one else was seriously hurt, and I'd appreciate a call back if you need anything else from me.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any

- "reason": one short sentence.
